title: Storyboard
lead: One keyframe per shot. Settle shot type, framing, blocking and transitions here, check the rhythm in the preview, then spend money on video.
spec: Aspect {{aspect}} · keyframes and video at {{w}}×{{h}} · change output spec

preview.label: Preview
preview.total: {{seconds}} s in total · current keyframes + dubbed lines + subtitles, free
preview.keys: Space plays / pauses; click the strip to jump

table.label: Shot table
table.mergeOf: Merge shot {{id}} with the next one

shot.label: Shot settings
shot.title: Shot {{id}}
shot.confirmed: {{id}} confirmed: first frame, references and settings are locked; ready for video.
shot.editTitle: Shot {{id}} is confirmed: the change reaches downstream
shot.tailOf: Continues from the last frame of {{id}}
shot.redrawn: The keyframe check failed; drawn again with what failed, it passed after {{count}} more tries.
shot.redrawnStill: The keyframe check failed and still fails after {{count}} more tries: only a warning, confirming goes on.
shot.noKeyframe: No keyframe yet. Pick the Keyframes component on the right and click Rerun.
shot.tailText: No keyframe of its own: video generation starts from the last frame of {{id}}, so action and light carry over.
shot.tailDefault: For a new keyframe, change the shot type to “same scene, new angle”.

typeHint.continuous: Continues an earlier shot's action: its last frame is the first frame here, so people and light don't jump.
typeHint.same_scene_cut: Same scene, new angle or framing: a new keyframe using the locked references.
typeHint.scene_change: New location: new keyframe and scene reference, no forced continuity with the last shot.

shot.desc: Picture description (intent layer of the keyframe prompt)
shot.refs: References (only locked assets are sent to the model)
shot.noMoreRefs: All locked assets are already added

audioHint.native: The video model makes voice and lip-sync itself (H3 native audio), using the locked voice as reference.
audioHint.tts: Record the line with the locked voice first, then lip-sync the video to it; steadier for voice-over and long lines.
audioHint.none: No voice in this shot; only ambience and effects.

shot.blockingHint: Drag people and the camera (or select one and use the arrow keys); it feeds the keyframe prompt.
shot.noLines: No script line for this shot.

durationSource.audio: Set by the spoken audio (a breath each side), at least {{min}} s
durationSource.manualMin: Set by hand · not shorter than its audio, {{min}} s
durationSource.planMin: From the shot plan · not shorter than its audio, {{min}} s

shot.splitHint: Longer than {{max}} s (one video take): split the shot
shot.mergeNone: No later shot in this scene
shot.mergeDone: The next shot is merged into {{id}}
shot.uploadDone: Uploaded as a new candidate of shot {{id}} and picked.

contract.label: Shot contract
contract.title: Shot contract
contract.hint: From the shot plan: the keyframe draws the start, the video keeps to it; a change marks both out of date

kindHint.performance: Performance: at most {{n}} actions, a change happens once; hesitation is acted, not repeated.
kindHint.action: Action: at most {{n}} actions, one after another.
kindHint.dialogue: Dialogue: at most {{n}} actions; lips move with the line.
kindHint.insert: Insert: small motion only (light, a drop, a slow drift); nothing happens.

contract.subject: Who / what
contract.inherited: Starts where {{id}} ends; a change makes it this shot's own
contract.propsHint: a state is set, not acted
contract.propLinked: In the picture from this scene: {{state}}
contract.deliveryHint: Inner voice and off-screen lines are not in the video; the edit lays them on their own track.

checks.label: Storyboard check
checks.title: Storyboard check · {{count}} to look at
checks.stale: the plan changed since the model's check
checks.cleanRules: The rules found nothing; the model has not checked yet
checks.shotTitle: {{count}} to look at in this shot:

code.undone: A change made, undone and made again: {{steps}}. Hesitation can be a pause, a breath.
code.insert_event: Something happens to the object in an insert (“{{words}}”): set the state, do not act it.
code.replay: Same scene, framing and still camera as {{other}}: cut together it looks like a replay.
code.inner_mouth: An inner-voice shot says “{{words}}”: lips stay closed on an inner voice.
code.state_jump: Its start does not match how {{other}} ends ({{subject}}).
code.cross_space: The start or end says 「{{words}}」 but the shot is in 「{{place}}」: is that seen from here? To film that side, split the shot or change its scene.
code.crowded: Too much for one shot: {{actions}}. Going through a door is a shot of its own; split the rest into the next shot.
code.lines_dropped: The script's action lines cannot be filmed as written ({{words}}): the video follows the picture description alone.
code.over_budget: More actions than the shot allows

item.light: light fits the time of day
item.facing: what she looks at faces her
item.extra: nothing more than the shot is for
